_note: Drives the uniform showcase. `spec` items become the interactive hotspots on the uniform drawing. Update measurements after the client confirms their uniform standard.

intro.headline: Every detail represents a standard.
intro.body: A uniform is the first thing anyone in your building reads about the people working in it. The Apex standard is a navy shirt, a chest logo, a name badge and a photo ID that says who this person is, what they do and which site they belong to — so nobody in your facility ever has to wonder.

photo.alt: Apex staff member in full uniform, standing portrait

spec.title: Chest logo
spec.detail: Wearer's left chest, 70 mm wide, embroidered flat stitch in bone and signal green.
spec.alt: Close crop of the embroidered Apex chest logo

spec.title: Name badge
spec.detail: Wearer's right chest, 75 x 24 mm. Name over role, on a signal-green plate.
spec.alt: Close crop of the Apex name badge

spec.title: Photo ID
spec.detail: 86 x 54 mm card on a breakaway lanyard. Photo, name, staff ID, site, and a colour band by service line.
spec.alt: Close crop of the Apex photo ID card and lanyard

spec.title: Epaulette
spec.detail: Supervisor grade only, so the person accountable on site is identifiable at a glance.

spec.title: Service tape
spec.detail: Left sleeve, service line in caps — housekeeping, security, technical, landscape or pest.

spec.title: Reflective hem
spec.detail: Technical and night-shift grades carry a 20 mm reflective band at the hem.
